input.body: We are writing to request a review of a deduction of $21.50 on order UE-tf02b, dated 2026-11-05, which was taken with the reason "missing item" (Lamb Biryani). Our records show the order was ready at 19:22 and picked up by the courier at 19:26, four minutes later [UE-tf02b:pickup_handoff]. This shows the order was handed off promptly after it was prepared. The order ticket lists Lamb Biryani as part of the order as placed, although the ticket alone does not show what was packed. This is all the evidence we hold on the order, and we do not wish to claim more than it shows. Based on it, we ask that you review the deduction and reverse it if the review supports that. Thank you for your time and consideration.
